mapper.select: SELECT batch_id, workload_id, idempotency_key, invocation_id, product_id, binding_hash, host_receipt_hash, signer_key_id, payload_sha256, state_class, verification_status, status, product_credit_eligible, business_closure_eligible, verified_at, create_time FROM fbs_truth_spine_receipt_batch WHERE workload_id = #{workloadId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_truth_spine_receipt_batch (batch_id, workload_id, idempotency_key, invocation_id, product_id, binding_hash, host_receipt_hash, signer_key_id, payload_sha256, state_class, verification_status, status, product_credit_eligible, business_closure_eligible, verified_at, create_time) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{workloadId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{invocationId}, #{productId}, #{bindingHash}, #{hostReceiptHash}, #{signerKeyId}, #{payloadSha256}, #{stateClass}, #{verificationStatus}, #{status}, #{productCreditEligible}, #{businessClosureEligible}, #{verifiedAt}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idempotency_key = VALUES(idempotency_key)
